text:
I can’t wait to make this Creamy Italian Sausage & Gnocchi soup all fall long. 

Comfort food at its finest! Recipe below! 

Creamy Italian Sausage+ Gnocchi Soup

Serves 4

Prep Time: ~10 minutes
Cook Time: ~25 minutes

INGREDIENTS:

​​1 lb mild Italian sausage
​​8 oz bag spinach, roughly chopped
​​2 tbsp minced garlic
​​3-4 cups low-sodium chicken broth I use @kettleandfire  use code Bailey20 for 20% off! (add a little more if you want it thinner) 
​​2 cups half-and-half or heavy cream
​​3 oz grated Parmesan cheese (I like freshly grated it melts better IMO) 
​​1 package gnocchi
​​1 tbsp tomato paste
​​1 tsp olive oil
​​1 tsp salt
​​1 tsp black pepper
​​1 tsp crushed red pepper flakes
​​1 tsp Italian seasoning
​​1 tsp oregano
​​1 tsp dried parsley
​​1 tsp onion powder
​​1 tsp garlic powder

DIRECTIONS:

​​Heat olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add minced garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds, until fragrant.

​​Add Italian sausage and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until completely browned and cooked through.

​​Add all seasonings and tomato paste. Stir until well combined and cook for 1–2 minutes.

​​Pour in chicken broth and bring to a boil. Add gnocchi and cook for 3–5 minutes, or according to package directions.

​​Reduce heat to low and stir in the half-and-half and Parmesan cheese.

​​Stir in the chopped spinach and allow it to wilt.

​​Let everything gently simmer for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the soup has thickened and become creamy.

​​Serve warm with extra Parmesan on top, if desired. Enjoy!
